description: Update one of your listings. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. screenshots replaces the full set when present: { id } keeps a shot from get_product, or { data } uploads base64 / a data URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; max 5; 10 MB). Empty screenshots clears them. video_url empty string clears the video. hidden hides or shows the listing in the catalog. free_for_now marks a free product so zero MRR shows as Free for now. verify true re-checks DNS TXT or the /.well-known/dealpuffin-verification file. badge_page_url sets the page that hosts the Featured on Dealpuffin badge (same domain as the product URL; empty string uses the homepage). verify_badge true claims the badge and crawls that page for the snippet.

badge_page_url.description: Page URL that hosts the Featured on Dealpuffin badge. Empty string clears to the product homepage.

free_for_now.description: When true, zero MRR proof readings show as Free for now instead of $0 or 0-1k.

verify.description: Re-check ownership (DNS TXT or /.well-known/dealpuffin-verification) when true.

verify_badge.description: When true, claim the badge and crawl the badge page (or homepage) for the snippet.

name: update_product
